engines.name: E1 — patterns in price
engines.does: Searches each stock's own price history for behaviour that repeats, keeps only what survives a locked final exam and still pays after fees, and trades it on paper.
engines.waiting_for: Tuesday's session and the daily Kite login.
coverage: 323 distinct patterns passed the final exam
minute-level pairs: 14,000 of 70,943 swept, 11,333,004 patterns validated (~11 days to finish, runs anyway)

engines.name: E2 — filings and analyst calls
engines.does: Checks whether a named source's published predictions are followed by a move worth trading.
engines.waiting_for: A feed that captures each call before its outcome is known, and the four accounting red-flag feeds.

engines.name: E3 — dated events
engines.does: Studies known, dated events — dividends, splits, index changes — and the forced buying and selling around them.
engines.waiting_for: A source that records the day each event was ANNOUNCED; until then its events are for study, never for trading.
coverage: 1,883 dividend and split events stored for study

engines.name: E4 — index options
engines.does: Sells defined-risk option spreads on Nifty and Bank Nifty when options are priced richer than expected movement — never a naked option.
engines.waiting_for: expiry calendar (needs the Kite instruments fetch (first login)); option chain (fetch wired (read-only quote/depth); populates in the live session).
coverage: 280 of 290 derivatives price histories loaded from AmiBroker
No backtest yet: forward-tested live only

engines.name: E6 — machine learning
engines.does: Would filter and size the other engines' calls; it never invents calls of its own.
engines.waiting_for: By its own rule it is built last — it needs a funded, fully examined strategy from each parent engine.

engines.name: E8 — the roof
engines.does: Sits above every engine, cancels calls that contradict each other, and holds the single total risk budget.
engines.waiting_for: A total risk budget and at least one funded engine.
coverage: Rules written; nothing to allocate yet
